text:
Priya (People Ops): Quick policy broadcast: we've published an Emergency Care Leave policy for sudden family caregiving needs (illness, accident, urgent childcare breakdown). Effective immediately. Up to 10 paid days per rolling 12 months for eligible employees. Full details + claim steps: https://redwood.atlassian.org/people-ops/leave/emergency-care-2026 

Benefits-Bot: Emergency Care Leave highlights: eligibility = regular full-time and part-time employees after 90 days of service; paid at base salary rate; can be taken intermittently or in a block; requires manager notification and a short claim form.

Sam Blake: Appreciate this. Does it stack with PTO or short-term disability?

Priya (People Ops): It does not stack with STD concurrently. Use Emergency Care first for immediate needs; if leave extends beyond Emergency Care and meets medical criteria, transition to STD may apply. PTO can be used separately or to top up after emergency days exhausted.

Carmen Ruiz: What documentation is needed? I don't want to share medical details.

Priya (People Ops): We only require a brief confirmation (note from provider or hospital admittance summary, or self-attestation for immediate urgent events) uploaded to the confidential portal. Managers will only see leave type and approved dates, not sensitive notes.

People-ops-Support: Filing tip: choose Leave > Emergency Care in the form, enter affected person (relation), dates, short reason, and attach docs if available. For urgent same-day needs, notify your manager and submit the form within 5 business days.

Sam Blake: If someone needs longer than 10 days, what then?

Priya (People Ops): After 10 paid days, options: use PTO, request unpaid leave, or apply for STD if medical criteria met. People-ops can help coordinate transitions and benefits.

Carmen Ruiz: Retroactive requests? I had to care for my partner last month.

Priya (People Ops): Retroactive emergency claims are allowed up to 30 days from the last day of leave. Submit via the portal with a short explanation and any supporting docs. We'll review case-by-case.

Benefits-Bot: Payroll note: Emergency Care pay is processed on the next payroll run after approval. For urgent reimbursements, include "URGENT-LEAVE" in the subject line when submitting docs.

Sam Blake: Manager approvals? What if manager is unavailable because of time zone differences?

Priya (People Ops): If your manager is unreachable, escalate to your manager's manager or People-ops-Support for interim approval. We built a manager fallback workflow into the form.

Carmen Ruiz: Will this be visible on pay statements?

Priya (People Ops): Yes, leave pay will show as Emergency Care pay line-item. HR and Payroll can provide breakdowns on request.

People-ops-Support: Office hours: short walkthrough Tue 09:00 PT in #people-ops-office-hours. We'll post a one-page FAQ with examples and sample wording to notify managers.

Sam Blake: Thanks Priya, helpful and timely.

Priya (People Ops): Thanks everyone . DM or email people-ops@redwood.com if you need help filing.
